creative_direction.name: Glacier Meltwater Basin
creative_direction.brief: Meltlight under ice: a photographic polar basin where a continuous matte glacier-ice sheet sweeps to a low horizon exactly at the true base line, and soft turquoise meltwater caustic ripples drift across the ice and the pale mist sky above. The cutout stands left of centre on that ice, contact shadow absorbed at its foot, while the right half stays calm for a wrapped Arial Narrow column: brand at column head, the name across two tall condensed lines, the eau de toilette line and a short glacier rule closing the column like a core-sample mark. Vertical overlap with the cap zone but wide horizontal clearance keeps the asymmetric grid deliberate; frozen white matte against saturated ocean-blue glass reads as water at both ends of its life.
creative_direction.material: matte glacier ice sheet with turquoise meltwater caustic light
creative_direction.lighting: soft high-key polar daylight, diffuse cool frontal with gentle moving caustic ripples, no hard shadows

background.prompt: Continuous matte glacier ice sheet in pale blue-white sweeping to a low horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame under a pale mist sky, soft turquoise meltwater caustic ripple light drifting across ice and sky, fine snow grain, soft high-key diffuse polar illumination, no objects
